Go package imports.description: Declares one or more Go imports used on the page

Go code block.description: Block of Go code (statement), can span multiple lines

Render expression.description: Renders the value of a Go expression into the HTML (with automatic escaping)

Conditional if.description: Conditional — renders the body if the condition is true

Conditional if/elif/else.description: Conditional with elif and else branches

For loop.description: Loop — repeats the body once per iteration

Switch.description: Switch with a case and a default
